glyph.isekai_mahou.link_hit.desc: Links two stages: the next form starts where the previous one hit, in the same direction.
glyph.isekai_mahou.link_end.desc: Links two stages: the next form starts where the previous one ended (projectile faded, zone expired, beam reached its end).
glyph.isekai_mahou.link_kill.desc: Links two stages: the next form starts where an enemy died to the previous one's damage.
glyph.isekai_mahou.link_leap.desc: Ends the spell: on hit, it repeats from the target toward the nearest enemy not hit yet. Each leap costs 15% of the spell's mana (min. 2); up to 64 leaps.
glyph.isekai_mahou.relentless.desc: Chain keeps jumping (range 8, 8% weaker per jump) while there is another enemy and you have mana to pay for the jump.
spell_error.isekai_mahou.link_needs_form: A form must come after %s (e.g. Projectile, Touch).
spell_error.isekai_mahou.form_needs_link: To use the form %s, put a link before it to connect it to the previous stage (e.g. On Hit).
spell_error.isekai_mahou.stage_form_not_: The form %s can't be a stage of a programmed spell (nor use Leap).
spell_error.isekai_mahou.stage_no_effect: Stage %s needs at least one effect.
spell_error.isekai_mahou.leap_not_last: Leap must be the last glyph of the spell.
spell_error.isekai_mahou.too_many_glyphs: Too many glyphs: %s (your level and Circle allow %s).
